description: This file implements a CSI translation library for Kubernetes, providing functions to translate between in-tree storage plugins and CSI drivers, including support for storage class, volume, and persistent volume translation, as well as plugin support checks and volume handle repair.

classes.name: CSITranslator
classes.description: A struct providing methods to translate storage objects between in-tree and CSI representations, and to check plugin support and migration status.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new instance of CSITranslator.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Translates an in-tree StorageClass to a CSI-compatible StorageClass.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Translates an in-tree volume source to a CSI PersistentVolume wrapped in a PV.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Translates an in-tree PersistentVolume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Translates a CSI PersistentVolume back to an in-tree PersistentVolume.

methods.name: IsMigratableIntreePluginByName
methods.description: Checks if an in-tree plugin with the given name has migration logic.

methods.name: IsMigratedCSIDriverByName
methods.description: Checks if a CSI driver with the given name is a migrated version of an in-tree plugin.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginNameFromSpec
methods.description: Retrieves the in-tree plugin name from a PersistentVolume or Volume.

methods.name: GetCSINameFromInTreeName
methods.description: Returns the CSI driver name that replaces the given in-tree plugin name.

methods.name: GetInTreeNameFromCSIName
methods.description: Returns the in-tree plugin name that is replaced by the given CSI driver name.

methods.name: IsPVMigratable
methods.description: Checks if a PersistentVolume has migration logic.

methods.name: IsInlineMigratable
methods.description: Checks if a Volume has migration logic.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Generates a correct volume handle based on driver and node ID.
